title: O*NET 15-1299.09 Information Technology Project Managers
rights: U.S. government work. O*NET content is in the public domain. Attribution retained.
retrieved_note: Pilot mapping from O*NET 15-1299.09 plus startup product context. Labeled offline fixture; not live retrieval.

excerpts.text: Plan, initiate, and manage information technology (IT) projects. Lead and guide the work of technical staff. Serve as liaison between business and technical aspects of projects. Plan project stages and assess business implications for each stage. Monitor progress to assure deadlines, standards, and cost targets are met.
Manage project execution to ensure adherence to budget, schedule, and scope.
Confer with project personnel to identify and resolve problems.

labeled_tasks.statement: Manage project execution to ensure adherence to budget, schedule, and scope.
labeled_tasks.output: A sequenced roadmap and explicit scope cuts
labeled_tasks.success_criteria: Stakeholders can see what is in, out, and at risk this cycle.

labeled_tasks.statement: Confer with project personnel to identify and resolve problems.
labeled_tasks.output: Resolved delivery blockers with named owners
labeled_tasks.success_criteria: Blockers are visible and either resolved or explicitly accepted.

labeled_skills.name: roadmap
labeled_skills.description: Sequence product work against capacity and risk.

labeled_skills.name: scope management
labeled_skills.description: Keep delivery inside budget, schedule, and agreed scope.

labeled_skills.name: facilitation
labeled_skills.description: Surface and resolve delivery problems with the people doing the work.

labeled_skills.name: customer
labeled_skills.description: Keep user problems visible while trading off scope.
